card.name: Storytelling openings like once upon a time
card.fires_on: Words inside fairy-tale or folk-tale openings, such as "Once upon a time, in a land" or "a long time ago", and early narrative sentences about a character.

modes.label: Fairy-tale opening
modes.description: Words in the stock opening phrase of a story such as once upon a time in a land far away.

modes.label: Early story narration
modes.description: Words introducing a character or following events in a folk tale.
modes.example: so far away there lived<< a>> girl named Jennifer. Jennifer was a student

card.writes: It pushes the model toward story-related words such as Stories and Story.
card.plain: It lights up when a text begins like a fairy tale or tells a folk story.
